import { ai } from "@warlock.js/ai";

declare const model: never;
declare const tools: never[];

export const writer = ai.agent({ name: "writer", model, tools });
export const ordered = ai.agent({ name: "ordered", model, tools, toolDispatch: "sequential" });
export const plain = ai.agent({ name: "plain", model });
export const child = ai.spawnSubAgent({ name: "child", model, tools, task: "go" });
